verification_details: Factual support verified: artifacts/sprint10l/dataset_fingerprint.json shows: Train positive rate = 0.62% (31,993 / 5,160,952), Validation positive rate = 4.07% (63,849 / 1,568,399), and Test positive rate = 23.20% (419,150 / 1,806,313).
Factual support verified: No drift correction, seasonal normalization, or self-calibrating layers exist in app/services/backfill/goes_backfill.py or app/services/ml/features.py.

Factual support verified: multi_instrument_overlap.json shows SoLEXS and HEL1OS have 915 and 960 daily parquet files respectively. Calibration and recovery reports show ~49% calendar days are missing due to duty cycles.

Factual support verified: app/services/ml/dataset_builder.py uses goes_df.asfreq('1Min') and ffill(limit=10) to force a regular 1-minute grid. There is no existing multi-cadence loader in the repository.
Factual support verified: dataset_fingerprint.json shows the train set spans 10 years, whereas the overlap train set is restricted to 1.5 years.
Factual support verified: production_metrics_snapshot.json shows baseline test metrics are computed over 2023-01-01 to 2026-06-14, which starts before SoLEXS operations (2023-12-13).
Factual support verified: The inference endpoint app/api/v1/endpoints/inference.py expects a single combined feature matrix. If any telemetry is missing, inference returns errors or degraded outputs.
